note: Skill tree. description is the text the original displays; effects are what its code does (they differ for a few nodes, see codeNote). costs are per level (cost.table[level]). requires is evaluated over links (neighbours); level 1 = at least one level, "max" = maxed.

nodes.name: node finder
nodes.description: +1% chance for blue enemies to spawn

nodes.name: connection buster
nodes.description: attack deals +5% damage per enemy in area

nodes.name: giant slayer
nodes.codeNote: Boss multiplier is applied to the shared damage variable inside the per-enemy loop, so once a boss is hit, later enemies in the same pulse also take the boosted damage (res://Scripts/Player/PlayerCursor.gd:53-54, res://Scripts/Autoloads/Globals.gd:51-52).

nodes.name: spawn exploders
nodes.description: +5% chance to spawn enemies that explode on death
nodes.codeNote: Exploder weight is taken from the Square weight each session (res://Scripts/Battle/BattleScene.gd:356-358).

nodes.name: sapper
nodes.description: restore +0.5 health when hitting an enemy

nodes.name: magnet
nodes.codeNote: +8 px pickup radius per level (base 16 px), i.e. +50% of base, additive.

nodes.name: swarming
nodes.codeNote: Description says +200% spawn rate; code adds 2.5 to spawn_rate_mod (+250%).

nodes.name: patcher
nodes.description: restore +0.5 health when picking up resources

nodes.name: pulse bolts
nodes.description: shoot projectiles outwards on each attack
nodes.codeNote: Grants 3 pulse bolts per attack (pulse_bolt_count += 3).

nodes.name: transplant
nodes.codeNote: Level-6 cost is 0.012 while every other level is 0.01 (as shipped).

nodes.name: processor acquisition
nodes.description: chance for yellow enemies to spawn
nodes.codeNote: yellow_enemy_chance += 0.001 (0.1% per spawn).

nodes.name: drainer
nodes.description: restore 10 health when hitting an enemy

nodes.name: auto pulser
nodes.description: get a drone that occasionally attacks nearby enemies
nodes.codeNote: Each level adds one drone (auto_pulser_count += 1).

nodes.name: b.i.g.
nodes.codeNote: Description says +100% attack size; code adds 1.0 to player_size (base 34 px), not to player_size_mod. Each level widens the reticle by 1 px x (1 + player_size_mod). Likely a bug in the original; reproduce as coded.
